title: Compact the Night opening
summary: Night keeps its personalised welcome but moves the nurse's actual allocation higher on phone screens, with a slower, more deliberate name reveal and a tighter selected-night hierarchy.
changes: Compacts the personalised Night hero and selected-night spacing so the nurse's actual allocation appears higher on phone screens without removing shift identity, date navigation, live status or Focus.
Slows the welcome animation deliberately, including a short pause before the nurse's name and a slower name reveal, while still playing only once per session and respecting reduced-motion settings.
Removes the duplicate visible Your night heading while retaining its accessible section label, reducing repeated hierarchy without changing roster content.

Tightens the handoff from selected-night context through freshness and Focus into the personal allocation, while preserving the live timeline rail, break information, AI Night Brief and daylight-saving clock-change behaviour.
Adds regression coverage for the slower personalised reveal and compact Night hierarchy.
